S1 restricts what Sam gave Rob (only grapes), while S2 talks about Sam giving Rob oranges, which would contradict S1 if both refer to all gifts; but without explicit scope over other items, the relation is not strictly entailed or contradicted in the logical sense, so they are treated as independent here.

S1 says the only thing Sam gave Mary was apples, so S2 claiming he also gave her bananas contradicts this.
S1 restricts the recipient of oranges to Ellen only, so S2 stating that Sue also received oranges from Sam contradicts S1.
if Sam only gave Rob oranges, then he did not give Rob apples; S2 is entailed by S1.
if Sam only gave bananas to Bill, then he did not give bananas to Ellen; S2 is entailed by S1.

if bananas were given only to Bill, then Mary did not receive bananas; S2 follows from S1.
